title: Two Citizens Arrested by IRGC Intelligence Agents in Mahabad
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kolbarnews, two citizens were arrested by IRGC intelligence agents in Mahabad.

According to the report, Diako Bayazidi, 35, and Mostafa Jooshkar, 52, were arrested on Sunday, October 18, at approximately 11:00 AM.

The report states that efforts by the detainees’ families to obtain information about their fate and whereabouts have so far been unsuccessful.

At the time of this report, no information was available regarding the reasons for their arrests or the charges brought against these two Mahabad residents.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kolbarnews, two citizens were arrested by IRGC intelligence agents in Mahabad.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Student Amirhossein Sheikh-Mohammadi Remains in Legal Limbo After Five Months in Detention
content:
According to HRANA, Amirhossein Sheikh-Mohammadi remains in detention. Based on information received by HRANA, he was transferred to another ward of Choobindar Prison in Qazvin in early-October. Despite five months having passed since his arrest, Mr. Sheikh-Mohammadi remains in legal limbo, awaiting judicial proceedings in his case and the scheduling of a court hearing.

The student has also been denied access to specialized medical treatment, despite having a broken tooth that requires dental care.

Additionally, Mr. Sheikh-Mohammadi has been unable to make phone calls to his family for approximately 20 days.

Amirhossein Sheikh-Mohammadi, a veterinary medicine student at Islamic Azad University in Karaj, was arrested
by security forces in the city on May 18, 2026.
snippet: According to HRANA, Amirhossein Sheikh-Mohammadi remains in detention. Based on information received by HRANA, he was transferred to another ward of Choobindar Prison in Qazvin in early-October.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: 39 Citizens Arrested in Qazvin Province in Connection with January 2026 Protests
content:
According to HRANA, citing Tasnim News Agency, 39 citizens were arrested by agents of the Intelligence Department in Qazvin Province.

In a published report, the Qazvin Province Intelligence Department claimed that the detainees had operated in eight separate groups and were involved in the destruction and burning of residential buildings, shops, banks, and a gas station on Babaei Street in Qazvin during the January 2026 protests.

The security agency also alleged that 10 of the detainees had been involved in the deaths of several security personnel.

Elsewhere in the report, the detainees were accused of having ties to the United States and Israel. The Qazvin Intelligence Department further claimed to have discovered and confiscated a number of firearms, bladed weapons, and quantities of alcoholic beverages from the detainees.

The report did not disclose the identities of those arrested, the exact dates of their arrests, their places of detention, their current status, or the latest developments in their judicial proceedings.

title: One Prisoner Executed in Bandar Abbas Prison
content:
According to HRANA, one prisoner was executed in Bandar Abbas Prison. HRANA has identified the prisoner, who was hanged at dawn on Monday, October 19, as Hamid Mohammadi, a resident of Fasa.

According to information obtained by HRANA, Mr. Mohammadi had previously been arrested on non-political charges and subsequently sentenced to death by judicial authorities.

HRANA is investigating further details regarding the charges against the prisoner and the judicial proceedings in his case.

Between October 10, 2025, and October 8, 2026, HRANA documented at least 2,003 executions across Iran, based on 1,857 reports, representing an increase of approximately 29% compared to the previous reporting period. During the same period, HRANA also documented 230 death sentences. For more detailed statistics and analysis of executions in Iran, read HRANA’s latest comprehensive report.
snippet: According to HRANA, one prisoner was executed in Bandar Abbas Prison. HRANA has identified the prisoner, who was hanged at dawn on Monday, October 19, as Hamid Mohammadi, a resident of Fasa.

title: Homayoun Shabankareh Sentenced to Death
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Homayoun Shabankareh was sentenced to death by Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Mehdi Sabzevarnejad (Sabzevari).

An informed source close to the family of Shabankareh, who is currently held at Karaj Central Penitentiary, confirmed the news to HRANA, stating: “Homayoun Shabankareh’s death sentence was issued on charges of moharebeh and espionage and was officially communicated to him on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Another judge involved in the case is Mehdi Razavi.”

Shabankareh was arrested at his home by security forces on May 14, 2026, in connection with the military conflict and subsequently transferred to Karaj Central Penitentiary. During his arrest, security agents searched his residence for three hours and confiscated several personal belongings, including his laptop.
snippet: Based on information received by HRANA, Homayoun Shabankareh was sentenced to death by Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Mehdi Sabzevarnejad (Sabzevari).
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Two Attorneys Arrested After Being Summoned to Tabriz Prosecutor’s Office
content:
According to HRANA, two attorneys were arrested in Tabriz on Sunday, October 18, 2026.

According to information received by HRANA, Reza Akbari Adl and Mohammad Esmaeili Allafi were arrested after appearing at the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office in Tabriz.

Despite efforts by the families and colleagues of the two attorneys to obtain information, judicial authorities and security agencies have so far provided no details regarding the reasons for their arrests or their fate.

As of the time of this report, the whereabouts of the two attorneys remain unknown.
snippet: According to HRANA, two attorneys were arrested in Tabriz on Sunday, October 18, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Saro Sadeghzadeh, 17-Year-Old Teenager, Arrested in Baneh
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kolbarnews, the 17-year-old Saro Sadeghzadeh was arrested on Saturday, October 17, 2026, by agents of the Ministry of Intelligence in Baneh, located in Kurdistan province, without a judicial warrant.

Following his arrest, he was transferred to one of the Ministry of Intelligence’s detention facilities in Sanandaj.

At the time of this report, no information was available regarding the reasons for his arrest or the charges brought against the teenager from Baneh.

title: January 2026 Protests: Mohammad-Javad Mohammadzadeh Tavasani Sentenced to Prison and Flogging
content:
According to HRANA, Mohammad-Javad Mohammadzadeh Tavasani, who is currently held in Azbaram Prison in Lahijan, has been sentenced to imprisonment and flogging.

Based on information received by HRANA, in late August 2026, the Lahijan Criminal Court sentenced Mr. Mohammadzadeh Tavasani to six months in prison and 20 lashes on the charge of “disrupting public order and peace.”

The remaining charges against him, which fall outside the jurisdiction of the Criminal Court, were referred to the Rasht Revolutionary Court. A hearing on this part of his case was held on September 15, 2026, but no verdict has been issued so far.

Previously, at Branch 1 of the Investigation Department of the Lahijan Prosecutor’s Office, he was formally charged with several offenses, including “acting against national security,” “destruction of public property,” “cooperating with foreign media and hostile groups or governments,” “disrupting public order and peace,” and cooperation with Israel.

Mr. Mohammadzadeh Tavasani was arrested at his home by security agents on February 12, 2026. During the arrest, agents searched his residence and confiscated his mobile phone.
snippet: According to HRANA, Mohammad-Javad Mohammadzadeh Tavasani, who is currently held in Azbaram Prison in Lahijan, has been sentenced to imprisonment and flogging.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Political Prisoner Kazem Alinejad Remains on Hunger Strike Amid Denial of Medical Care
content:
According to HRANA, Kazem Alinejad, a political prisoner held in Evin Prison, is now on the fifth day of his hunger strike.

Alinejad began his hunger strike on Friday, October 16, 2026, in protest against the denial of medical services, lack of access to necessary medications, and prison authorities’ disregard for his physical health. Five days after the strike began, his demands for medical care remain unmet, and he continues his hunger strike.

The political prisoner suffers from heart, lung, and kidney conditions, as well as diabetes and high blood pressure. Despite these serious health issues, he has been denied access to some of his essential medications. His insulin intake has also increased due to elevated blood sugar levels, while his repeated requests to be transferred to medical facilities outside the prison have gone unanswered.
snippet: According to HRANA, Kazem Alinejad, a political prisoner held in Evin Prison, is now on the fifth day of his hunger strike.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Healthcare Worker Yousef Dehghani Sentenced to Prison, Exile, Flogging, and a Fine
content:
HRANA – Yousef Dehghani, a healthcare worker and one of those arrested during the January 2026 protests in Qorveh, has been sentenced to one year in prison, a two-year suspended prison term, two years of internal exile, 31 lashes, and a fine.

According to HRANA, citing Kolbarnews, Yousef Dehghani, a healthcare worker in Qorveh, has been sentenced to multiple punishments by the city’s Criminal and Revolutionary Courts, several months after his arrest.

According to the report, the Qorveh Criminal Court, presided over by Judge Hadi Khani, sentenced Dehghani to one year in prison, two years of internal exile in the city of Zabol, and 31 lashes.

In a separate part of the same case, the Qorveh Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Hossein Bigdelou, sentenced him to a two-year suspended prison term and a fine. The amount of the fine has not been disclosed.

Yousef Dehghani was arrested by Ministry of Intelligence agents at his workplace in a hospital during the January 2026 protests.
